slide.title: Read every page from the same Saga version
slide.takeaway: Keep the query unchanged while following cursors. If the Saga changes, restart from the first page.

item.label: Start without a cursor
item.description: The first page begins at offset zero. An omitted limit uses the default; a limit outside the accepted range is rejected before a page is returned.

references.note: Starts uncursored pagination at zero after applying the default or validating the supplied page limit.

item.label: Save the next cursor
item.description: The token records operation, normalized filters, snapshot and next offset. Its unkeyed checksum detects corruption; it does not authenticate the caller or grant access.

references.note: Issues an opaque checksummed continuation containing the operation, normalized filters, snapshot, and next offset when rows remain.

item.label: Continue the same query
item.description: The next command must preserve the operation and normalized filters. The token is checked against the current snapshot before its offset is used.

references.note: Accepts a continuation only after its canonical encoding, checksum, operation, filters, snapshot, and offset all match.

item.label: Correct an invalid cursor
item.description: Malformed tokens, checksum failures, changed operations or filters, and invalid offsets return invalid_argument. Reusing the same invalid token will not repair the request.

references.note: Rejects malformed, tampered, cross-query, cross-filter, and out-of-range continuations as invalid_argument.
Rejects malformed, tampered, cross-query, cross-filter, and out-of-range continuations as invalid_argument.
Rejects malformed, tampered, cross-query, cross-filter, and out-of-range continuations as invalid_argument.
Exercises valid continuation, tampering, and cross-operation reuse against the real query CLI.

item.label: Restart after a change
item.description: A valid token from another snapshot returns retryable stale_snapshot. Restart without that cursor so a completed traversal does not combine records from different versions.

references.note: Proves that advancing the Saga snapshot turns an otherwise valid cursor into retryable stale_snapshot.
Returns retryable stale_snapshot when a valid cursor belongs to a different application snapshot.

item.label: Stop at the last page
item.description: The last page sets has_more to false and omits a continuation token. A caller can check that accumulated returned counts match total before treating the traversal as complete.

references.note: Marks the terminal page with has_more false and omits next_cursor when the filtered total has been reached.

item.label: A checksum is not a signature
item.description: An opaque, checksummed cursor may look signed. Its checksum has no secret key: it catches corruption, not forgery. Treat it as a continuation marker, never proof of identity or permission.
item.body: An opaque, checksummed cursor may look signed. Its checksum has no secret key: it catches corruption, not forgery. Treat it as a continuation marker, never proof of identity or permission.

criterion_links.rationale: Explains a constraint of the documented query contract: A checksum is not a signature.
